Bio:
In this scenario, both Princesses, Peach & Daisy will have to change most of their moves into using butt moves. Their standard or light attack will still be slapping and floating in the air, but the rest of their attacks will be using their butts. Most moves are bombers, but stronger and sometimes more effective. For example, their down special will have the exact moves as Bowser, Bowser Bomb, but it's Peach or Daisy Bombs and they're faster than Bowser's. Toad will replace their counterattack with ass. The counterattack is when they show their asses and whoever hits them, their butts will jiggle and hits the opponent back. They're far more dangerous than using Toads. Now, their Final Smash move will change from Peach/Daisy Blossom to their massive ass attack moves with both of them attacking the victim at the same time. With the Final Smash move, they'll keep hitting the opponent with their asses, then they'll jump and launches themselves butts first, sandwiching the opponent directly in the face and torso. It's so effective that every single opponent can fly off the stage in an instant. Good thing it's in the Super Smash Bros. game because, in real life, they could break anyone's face open with that butt sandwich move...anyway, overall, they're very powerful, even if they don't look very muscular, their asses are stronger than it looks.
Fun fact: Daisy's booty is slightly stronger, but Peach's booty is a bit heavier. So imagine feeling their strength and mass combined...
